setup: A circle has radius [[r]] and a sector whose central angle is $[[frac]]$.

steps.say: A sector is a slice of the circle, so its area is the same fraction of the whole that its angle is of a full turn: $A = \tfrac{1}{2} r^{2} \theta$ when $\theta$ is in radians. The $\tfrac{1}{2}$ is the same factor that makes a triangle half its bounding rectangle.
Here $A = \tfrac{1}{2} ([[r]])^{2} \times [[frac]] = [[value]]\pi$, so the multiplier written in front of $\pi$ is [[value]]. A full turn of $2\pi$ returns the whole circle, $\pi r^{2}$.
